theorem weakTimeDerivative_congr_ae {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    {f g df dg : ℝ → Fourier}
    (hf : f =ᵐ[volume.restrict (Set.Icc a b)] g)
    (hd : df =ᵐ[volume.restrict (Set.Icc a b)] dg) :
    WeakTimeDerivative a b f df ↔ WeakTimeDerivative a b g dg := by
  have hint {F G : ℝ → Fourier} (he : F =ᵐ[volume.restrict (Set.Icc a b)] G)
      (ψ : ℝ → ℂ) (k : ℤ) :
      (∫ t : ℝ in a..b, ψ t * F t k) = (∫ t : ℝ in a..b, ψ t * G t k) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae_restrict
    rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hab, restrict_Ioc_eq_restrict_Icc]
    filter_upwards [he] with t ht
    rw [ht]
  constructor
  · intro h k φ hφ hcomp hsupp
    rw [← hint hf (fun t => ((deriv φ t : ℝ) : ℂ)) k,
      ← hint hd (fun t => ((φ t : ℝ) : ℂ)) k]
    exact h k φ hφ hcomp hsupp
  · intro h k φ hφ hcomp hsupp
    rw [hint hf (fun t => ((deriv φ t : ℝ) : ℂ)) k,
      hint hd (fun t => ((φ t : ℝ) : ℂ)) k]
    exact h k φ hφ hcomp hsupp


/-- The unnormalized source Hilbert norm is an actual rescaling of the complete
weighted coefficient space, not a change to the target norm. -/
theorem source_rescaled_norm {s : ℝ} (f : Sobolev s) :
    ‖(sourceNormalization : ℂ) • f‖ = sourceNorm s f.val := by
  rw [norm_smul, sobolev_norm]
  simp only [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg sourceNormalization_pos.le, sourceNorm]

theorem source_rescaled_memLp_iff {s : ℝ} (a b : ℝ) (f : ℝ → Sobolev s) :
    MemLp ((sourceNormalization : ℂ) • f) ∞ (volume.restrict (Set.Icc a b)) ↔
      MemLp f ∞ (volume.restrict (Set.Icc a b)) := by
  have hκ : (sourceNormalization : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr sourceNormalization_pos.ne'
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hi := h.const_smul ((sourceNormalization : ℂ)⁻¹)
    simpa only [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hκ, one_smul] using hi
  · intro h
    exact h.const_smul (sourceNormalization : ℂ)

    (eLpNorm ((sourceNormalization : ℂ) • f) ∞ (volume.restrict (Set.Icc a b))).toReal =
      sourceLInfinity a b f := by
  rw [eLpNorm_const_smul, ENNReal.toReal_mul]
  simp only [toReal_enorm, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg sourceNormalization_pos.le, sourceLInfinity]


theorem step_grid_to_universal (h : LiWuStep52Grid) : LiWuStep52 := by
  intro γ hγ hγ1 τ hτ n f hf hfm
  let L := n + 1
  have hL : 0 < L := by dsimp [L]; omega
  have hLr : 0 < (L : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hL
  have hT : 0 < (L : ℝ) * τ := mul_pos hLr hτ
  have heq : ((L : ℝ) * τ) / (L : ℝ) = τ := by field_simp
  have hh := h γ hγ hγ1 ((L : ℝ) * τ) hT L hL n (by dsimp [L]; omega) f hf hfm
  simpa only [heq] using hh

theorem step_universal_to_grid (h : LiWuStep52) : LiWuStep52Grid := by
  intro γ hγ hγ1 T hT L hL
  dsimp only
  intro n _ f hf hfm
  exact h γ hγ hγ1 (T / (L : ℝ)) (div_pos hT (by exact_mod_cast hL)) n f hf hfm

theorem step_grid_iff_universal : LiWuStep52Grid ↔ LiWuStep52 :=
  ⟨step_grid_to_universal, step_universal_to_grid⟩

theorem step_grid_to_historical (h : LiWuStep52Grid) : LiWuStepIdentity :=

/-- Restricting an upper norm bound to nonnegative values loses no original
case: all data hypotheses in a negative-bound case are contradictory. -/
theorem bit42_43_all_bounds_iff : BITTheorems42And43AllBounds ↔ BITTheorems42And43 := by
  constructor
  · intro h s hs M _ T hT r _
    exact h s hs M T hT r
  · intro h s hs M T hT r
    by_cases hM : 0 ≤ M
    · by_cases hr : 0 ≤ r
      · exact h s hs M hM T hT r hr
      · have impossible (f : Fourier) (he : homogeneousNorm s f = r) : False := by
          have := homogeneousNorm_nonneg s f
          linarith
        refine ⟨0, le_rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro m hm f v hfr hf he
          exact False.elim (impossible f he)
        · intro hs' f hfr hf he
          exact False.elim (impossible f he)
    · have impossible (f : Fourier) (he : homogeneousNorm 0 f ≤ M) : False := by
        have := homogeneousNorm_nonneg 0 f
        linarith
      refine ⟨0, le_rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro m hm f v hfr hf he hfm
        exact False.elim (impossible f hfm)
      · intro hs' f hfr hf he hfm
        exact False.elim (impossible f hfm)

theorem J_shift (a r : ℝ) (f g : Fourier) :
    airy (-a) (J r (airy a f) (airy a g)) = J (a + r) f g := by
  simp only [J, inverseDerivative_airy, ← airy_add_time]
  rw [show -a + -r = -(a + r) by ring, show r + a = a + r by ring]

theorem source_stage_shift (a t : ℝ) (f g : Fourier) :
    sourceBilinearStage a t f g =
      airy (-a) (sourceBilinearStage 0 (t - a) (airy a f) (airy a g)) := by
  simp only [← bilinearStage_eq_source, bilinearStage, airy_smul, airy_sub, J_shift]
  rw [show a + (t - a) = t by ring, add_zero]

theorem source_stage_power_nonneg {γ ε β : ℝ} (hγ : 0 < γ) (_hγ1 : γ ≤ 1)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hβ : β ≤ 1 + γ) : 0 ≤ sourceStagePower γ ε β := by
  have hd : 0 < 1 + γ - sourceStageLower γ ε := by
    unfold sourceStageLower
    split_ifs <;> linarith
  exact div_nonneg (by linarith) hd.le

/-- Preserve the source's complete-grid quantification. An arbitrary shorter
step is embedded in a grid with the *same* T; its grid step is between tau and
2*tau. Airy conjugation moves its start to grid point zero. -/
theorem stage_grid_to_historical (h : LiWuLemma72Grid) : LiWuStageEstimate := by
  intro T hT γ hγ hγ1 ε hε β hb hb1
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hbound⟩ := h T hT γ hγ hγ1 ε hε β hb hb1
  let q := sourceStagePower γ ε β
  have hq : 0 ≤ q := source_stage_power_nonneg hγ hγ1 hε hb1
  refine ⟨C * (2 : ℝ) ^ q, mul_pos hC (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _), ?_⟩
  intro τ n t hτ hn ht f g hf hg hfm hgm
  have hτT : τ ≤ T := by
    have hn0 : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
    push_cast at hn
    nlinarith
  have hx : 1 ≤ T / τ := (le_div_iff₀ hτ).mpr (by simpa using hτT)
  let L := ⌊T / τ⌋₊
  have hL : 0 < L := Nat.floor_pos.mpr hx
  have hLr : 0 < (L : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hL
  have hL1 : 1 ≤ (L : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hL
  have hfloor : (L : ℝ) ≤ T / τ := Nat.floor_le (by positivity)
  have hfloor2 : T / τ < (L : ℝ) + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
  let θ := T / (L : ℝ)
  have hθ : 0 < θ := div_pos hT hLr
  have hτθ : τ ≤ θ := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hLr).mpr
    have hh := (le_div_iff₀ hτ).mp hfloor
    nlinarith
  have hθτ : θ ≤ 2 * τ := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hLr).mpr
    have hh : T / τ ≤ 2 * (L : ℝ) := by linarith
    have hh' := (div_le_iff₀ hτ).mp hh
    nlinarith
  let a := (n : ℝ) * τ
  have ht0 : t - a ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) θ := by
    have h1 := ht.1
    have h2 := ht.2
    push_cast at h2
    constructor <;> dsimp [a] <;> linarith
  have hfm' : MeanZero (airy a f) := by simpa only [MeanZero, airy_mean] using hfm
  have hgm' : MeanZero (airy a g) := by simpa only [MeanZero, airy_mean] using hgm
  have hz := hbound L hL 0 hL (t - a)
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, Nat.zero_add, Nat.cast_one, one_mul] at hz
  obtain ⟨hm, hbnd⟩ := hz ht0 (airy a f) (airy a g) (airy_inSobolev hf a) (airy_inSobolev hg a) hfm' hgm'
  have hmember := airy_inSobolev hm (-a)
  rw [← source_stage_shift] at hmember
  refine ⟨hmember, ?_⟩
  have hnrm : sourceNorm β (sourceBilinearStage a t f g) =
      sourceNorm β (sourceBilinearStage 0 (t - a) (airy a f) (airy a g)) := by
    rw [source_stage_shift]
    simp only [sourceNorm, airy_hNorm]
  change sourceNorm β (sourceBilinearStage a t f g) ≤ _
  rw [hnrm]
  simp only [sourceNorm, airy_hNorm] at hbnd
  change sourceNorm β (sourceBilinearStage 0 (t - a) (airy a f) (airy a g)) ≤
    C * θ ^ q * sourceNorm γ f * sourceNorm γ g at hbnd
  have hpow : θ ^ q ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ q * τ ^ q := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (2 * τ) ^ q := Real.rpow_le_rpow hθ.le hθτ hq
      _ = _ := Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) hτ.le
  have hnf : 0 ≤ sourceNorm γ f := mul_nonneg sourceNormalization_pos.le (hNorm_nonneg _ _)
  have hng : 0 ≤ sourceNorm γ g := mul_nonneg sourceNormalization_pos.le (hNorm_nonneg _ _)
  calc
    _ ≤ C * θ ^ q * sourceNorm γ f * sourceNorm γ g := hbnd
    _ ≤ C * ((2 : ℝ) ^ q * τ ^ q) * sourceNorm γ f * sourceNorm γ g :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow hC.le) hnf) hng
    _ = _ := by ring

end BareModelCompletion

/-- Only finitely many modes move. Source H0 continuity therefore preserves
every higher initial Sobolev regularity; no new source assumption is used. -/
theorem galerkin_higher_continuity {s T : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) {m : ℕ}
    {f : Fourier} (hf : InHomSobolev s f) {v : ℝ → Fourier}
    (hc : HomSobolevContinuousOn 0 T v) (hv : SourceGalerkinODE m T f v) :
    HomSobolevContinuousOn s T v := by
  have htail (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T) := hv.tail_stationary (le_refl (0 : ℝ)) hc ht
  have hlow (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T) : InHomSobolev s (cutoff m (v t)) :=
    (cutoff_inSobolev_all s m (v t)).to_homogeneous hs (cutoff_meanZero (hc.1 t ht).1 m)
  have hmem (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T) : InHomSobolev s (v t) := by
    have he : v t = cutoff m (v t) + highCutoff m f := by
      rw [← htail t ht]
      unfold highCutoff
      abel
    rw [he]
    exact (hlow t ht).add (hf.sub (hf.cutoff m))
  refine ⟨hmem, ?_⟩
  intro t ht ε hε
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hd⟩ := hc.2 t ht (ε / weight s (m : ℤ)) (div_pos hε (weight_pos _ _))
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
  intro r hr hrt
  have he : v r - v t = cutoff m (v r - v t) := by
    rw [cutoff_sub]
    calc
      _ = (cutoff m (v r) + highCutoff m (v r)) -
          (cutoff m (v t) + highCutoff m (v t)) := by unfold highCutoff; abel
      _ = _ := by rw [htail r hr, htail t ht]; abel
  have hD : InHomSobolev 0 (v r - v t) := (hc.1 r hr).sub (hc.1 t ht)
  have hg := cutoff_gain_bound hs (hD.to_inhomogeneous (le_refl 0)) m
  simp only [zero_add] at hg
  have hn := homogeneousNorm_le_hNorm hs hg.1 (cutoff_meanZero hD.1 m)
  have hb : homogeneousNorm s (v r - v t) ≤ weight s (m : ℤ) * homogeneousNorm 0 (v r - v t) := by
    calc
      _ = homogeneousNorm s (cutoff m (v r - v t)) := congrArg (homogeneousNorm s) he
      _ ≤ hNorm s (cutoff m (v r - v t)) := hn
      _ ≤ _ := by simpa only [homogeneousNorm_zero] using hg.2
  have hh := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (hd r hr hrt) (weight_pos s (m : ℤ))
  have heps : weight s (m : ℤ) * (ε / weight s (m : ℤ)) = ε := by
    field_simp [(weight_pos s (m : ℤ)).ne']
  rw [heps] at hh
  exact hb.trans_lt hh

theorem source_galerkin_family (h41 : BITProposition41) {s T : ℝ}
    (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hT : 0 < T) (f : Fourier) (hfr : RealValued f) (hf : InHomSobolev s f) :
    ∃ G : ℕ → ℝ → Fourier, ∀ m, HomSobolevContinuousOn s T (G m) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, RealValued (G m t)) ∧ SourceGalerkinODE (m + 1) T f (G m) := by
  choose G hG hEnergy using (fun m : ℕ => h41 f hfr (hf.of_le hs) (m + 1) (by omega))
  refine ⟨G, ?_⟩
  intro m
  obtain ⟨hc, hr, hODE⟩ := hG m T hT
  exact ⟨galerkin_higher_continuity hs hf hc hODE, hr, hODE⟩


/-- Two directions of the source Galerkin solution-class correspondence. -/
theorem galerkin_continuity_iff {s T : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) {m : ℕ}
    {f : Fourier} (hf : InHomSobolev s f) {v : ℝ → Fourier}
    (hv : SourceGalerkinODE m T f v) :
    HomSobolevContinuousOn s T v ↔ HomSobolevContinuousOn 0 T v :=
  ⟨fun hc => hc.of_le hs, fun hc => galerkin_higher_continuity hs hf hc hv⟩


/-- Solving the source Fourier sum constraint does not change its index domain. -/
def tripleSumEquiv (k : ℤ) : (ℤ × ℤ) ≃
    {q : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ // q.1 + q.2.1 + q.2.2 = k} where
  toFun q := ⟨(q.1, q.2, k - q.1 - q.2), by dsimp; omega⟩
  invFun q := (q.val.1, q.val.2.1)
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv := by
    rintro ⟨⟨a, b, c⟩, h⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    dsimp only
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · apply Prod.ext
      · rfl
      · dsimp at h ⊢
        omega

def quadrupleSumEquiv (k : ℤ) : (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) ≃
    {q : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ // q.1 + q.2.1 + q.2.2.1 + q.2.2.2 = k} where
  toFun q := ⟨(q.1, q.2.1, q.2.2, k - q.1 - q.2.1 - q.2.2), by dsimp; omega⟩
  invFun q := (q.val.1, q.val.2.1, q.val.2.2.1)
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv := by
    rintro ⟨⟨a, b, c, d⟩, h⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    dsimp only
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · apply Prod.ext
      · rfl
      · apply Prod.ext
        · rfl
        · dsimp at h ⊢
          omega

theorem triple_tsum_reindex (k : ℤ)
    (F : {q : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ // q.1 + q.2.1 + q.2.2 = k} → ℂ) :
    (∑' q : ℤ × ℤ, F (tripleSumEquiv k q)) = ∑' q, F q :=
  (tripleSumEquiv k).tsum_eq F

theorem quadruple_tsum_reindex (k : ℤ)
    (F : {q : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ // q.1 + q.2.1 + q.2.2.1 + q.2.2.2 = k} → ℂ) :
    (∑' q : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ, F (quadrupleSumEquiv k q)) = ∑' q, F q :=
  (quadrupleSumEquiv k).tsum_eq F

theorem nonresonant_zero_denominator {ι : Type*} (N D : ι → ℂ) :
    (∑' q, N q / D q) = ∑' q, if D q = 0 then 0 else N q / D q := by
  apply tsum_congr
  intro q
  by_cases hq : D q = 0 <;> simp [hq]

theorem cubic_zero_input (f g h : Fourier) (hf : MeanZero f) (hg : MeanZero g) (hh : MeanZero h)
    (a b c : ℤ) (hz : a = 0 ∨ b = 0 ∨ c = 0) (E D : ℂ) :

  have hf0 : f 0 = 0 := hf
  have hg0 : g 0 = 0 := hg
  have hh0 : h 0 = 0 := hh
  rcases hz with hz | hz | hz <;> simp [hz, hf0, hg0, hh0]

theorem quartic_zero_input (f g h q : Fourier)
    (hf : MeanZero f) (hg : MeanZero g) (hh : MeanZero h) (hq : MeanZero q)
    (a b c d : ℤ) (hz : a = 0 ∨ b = 0 ∨ c = 0 ∨ d = 0) (E D : ℂ) :

theorem source_global_galerkin_family (h41 : BITProposition41) {s : ℝ}
    (hs : 0 ≤ s) (f : Fourier) (hfr : RealValued f) (hf : InHomSobolev s f) :
    ∃ G : ℕ → ℝ → Fourier, BITGalerkinFamily s f G := by

/-- The differentiated old mode is c+d. Its nonzero condition survives the
cancellation producing (3.28), in addition to all nonresonant denominators. -/
theorem quartic_nonres_domain (a b c d : ℤ) :
    (a ≠ 0 ∧ b ≠ 0 ∧ c ≠ 0 ∧ d ≠ 0 ∧ c + d ≠ 0 ∧
      c + d + a ≠ 0 ∧ a + b ≠ 0 ∧ b + c + d ≠ 0) ↔
    (a ≠ 0 ∧ b ≠ 0 ∧ c ≠ 0 ∧ d ≠ 0 ∧ c + d ≠ 0 ∧
      (a + b) * (a + c + d) * (b + c + d) ≠ 0) := by
  rw [show c + d + a = a + c + d by ring]
  simp only [mul_ne_zero_iff]
  tauto

  have heq := hu0 v hvweak

  have hu : BITUniqueWeak T f v := fun w hw t ht => (hu0 w hw t ht).trans (heq t ht).symm
  have he : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, homogeneousNorm 0 (v t) = homogeneousNorm 0 f := by
    intro t ht
    rw [heq t ht]
    exact he0 t ht
  have hsphere : ∀ S : ℝ, 0 < S → ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧
      ∀ f g : Fourier, RealValued f → RealValued g → InHomSobolev s f → InHomSobolev s g →
      homogeneousNorm s f = S → homogeneousNorm s g = S →
      ∀ v w : ℝ → Fourier, SourceWeakSolution T f v → SourceWeakSolution T g w →
      HomSobolevContinuousOn s T v → HomSobolevContinuousOn s T w →
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, homogeneousNorm s (v t - w t) ≤ K * homogeneousNorm s (f - g) := by
    intro S hS
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, C, hC, hb⟩ := h51.dependence s hs T hT
    have hCS : 0 < C (2 * S) := hC (2 * S) (by positivity)
    refine ⟨(C (2 * S) + 1) ^ (⌊T / δ (2 * S)⌋₊ + 1), by positivity, ?_⟩
    intro a b har hbr ha hb' haN hbN va vb hva hvb hvaC hvbC
    have hh := hb b a hbr har hb' ha vb va hvb hva hvbC hvaC
    simpa only [haN, hbN, show S + S = 2 * S by ring] using hh
  have hl := local_lipschitz_from_spheres hL (by linarith : 0 < s) hT
    (source_exists_high h41 h43 h51 hs hT) hsphere hfr hf hvweak hc
  exact ⟨hc, (fun w hw _ => hu w hw), hl, he⟩

theorem bitHomSup_le_of_ae {s T A : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (v : ℝ → Fourier)
    (hb : ∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 T), homogeneousNorm s (v t) ≤ A) :
    bitHomSup s T v ≤ A := by
  have he : eLpNorm (fun t => homogeneousNorm s (v t)) ∞ (volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 T)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal A := by
    rw [eLpNorm_exponent_top]
    apply eLpNormEssSup_le_of_ae_bound
    filter_upwards [hb] with t ht
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (homogeneousNorm_nonneg _ _)] using ht
  have ht := ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top he
  simpa only [bitHomSup, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hA] using ht

theorem homogeneous_essential_sub {s T : ℝ} {v w : ℝ → Fourier}
    (hv : HomogeneousEssentiallyBounded s T v) (hw : HomogeneousEssentiallyBounded s T w) :
    HomogeneousEssentiallyBounded s T (fun t => v t - w t) := by
  obtain ⟨V, hV, heV⟩ := hv
  obtain ⟨W, hW, heW⟩ := hw
  refine ⟨fun t => V t - W t, hV.sub hW, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [heV, heW] with t ht ht'
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · change v t 0 - w t 0 = 0
    rw [ht.1, ht'.1, sub_self]
  · change (V t).val - (W t).val = homogeneousWeighted s (v t - w t)
    rw [ht.2, ht'.2, homogeneousWeighted_sub]
    rfl

theorem homogeneous_essential_scalar_memLp {s T : ℝ} {v : ℝ → Fourier}
    (hv : HomogeneousEssentiallyBounded s T v) :
    MemLp (fun t => homogeneousNorm s (v t)) ∞ (volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 T)) := by
  obtain ⟨V, hV, heV⟩ := hv
  have he : (fun t => ‖V t‖) =ᵐ[volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 T)] (fun t => homogeneousNorm s (v t)) := by
    filter_upwards [heV] with t ht
    have hi : InHomSobolev s (v t) := ⟨ht.1, by rw [← ht.2]; exact (V t).property⟩
    have hh : homogeneousLp s (v t) hi = V t := Subtype.ext ht.2.symm
    rw [← hh, homogeneousLp_norm]
  exact (memLp_congr_ae he).mp hV.norm

/-- Both directions of the L-infinity norm/essential-bound correspondence.
Thus the a.e. formulation of the published (6.7) conclusion loses no content. -/
theorem bitHomSup_le_iff {s T B : ℝ} {v : ℝ → Fourier}
    (hv : HomogeneousEssentiallyBounded s T v) (hB : 0 ≤ B) :
    bitHomSup s T v ≤ B ↔
      ∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 T), homogeneousNorm s (v t) ≤ B := by
  constructor
  · intro hb
    have hm := homogeneous_essential_scalar_memLp hv
    have hfinite : eLpNormEssSup (fun t => homogeneousNorm s (v t))
        (volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 T)) ≠ ∞ := by
      simpa only [eLpNorm_exponent_top] using hm.2.ne
    filter_upwards [ae_le_eLpNormEssSup (f := fun t => homogeneousNorm s (v t))
      (μ := volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 T))] with t ht
    have hh := ENNReal.toReal_mono hfinite ht
    have hh' : homogeneousNorm s (v t) ≤ bitHomSup s T v := by
      simpa only [bitHomSup, eLpNorm_exponent_top, toReal_enorm, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg (homogeneousNorm_nonneg _ _)] using hh
    exact hh'.trans hb
  · exact bitHomSup_le_of_ae hB v

theorem dependence67_norm_to_ae (h : BITDependence67Norm) : BITDependence67 := by
  intro s hs hs1 T hT M hM
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ, C, hC, C', hC', hb⟩ := h s hs hs1 T hT M hM
  refine ⟨τ, hτ, C, hC, C', hC', ?_⟩
  intro f g hfr hgr hf hg v w hv hw hvB hwB hbound
  have hK : 0 ≤ C' * (2 * C + 1) ^ (⌊T / τ⌋₊ + 1) := by positivity
  exact (bitHomSup_le_iff (homogeneous_essential_sub hvB hwB)
    (mul_nonneg hK (homogeneousNorm_nonneg _ _))).mp
    (hb f g hfr hgr hf hg v w hv hw hvB hwB hbound)

theorem dependence67_ae_to_norm (h : BITDependence67) : BITDependence67Norm := by
  intro s hs hs1 T hT M hM
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ, C, hC, C', hC', hb⟩ := h s hs hs1 T hT M hM
  refine ⟨τ, hτ, C, hC, C', hC', ?_⟩
  intro f g hfr hgr hf hg v w hv hw hvB hwB hbound
  have hK : 0 ≤ C' * (2 * C + 1) ^ (⌊T / τ⌋₊ + 1) := by positivity
  exact (bitHomSup_le_iff (homogeneous_essential_sub hvB hwB)
    (mul_nonneg hK (homogeneousNorm_nonneg _ _))).mpr
    (hb f g hfr hgr hf hg v w hv hw hvB hwB hbound)

theorem dependence67_iff : BITDependence67Norm ↔ BITDependence67 :=
  ⟨dependence67_norm_to_ae, dependence67_ae_to_norm⟩

/-- The common (4.13)/(4.20) bound transfers to every continuous weak flow by
original uniqueness. Its dependence remains fixed before the initial datum. -/
theorem low_fixed_sphere_bound (h41 : BITProposition41) (h43 : BITTheorems42And43) (h63 : BITTheorem63)
    {s T S : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1 / 2) (hT : 0 < T) (hS : 0 < S) :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 ≤ A ∧ ∀ f : Fourier, RealValued f → InHomSobolev s f →
      homogeneousNorm s f = S → ∀ v : ℝ → Fourier, SourceWeakSolution T f v →
      ∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 T), homogeneousNorm s (v t) ≤ A := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hgal, hl⟩ := h43 s hs.le S hS.le T hT S hS.le
  refine ⟨A, hA, ?_⟩
  intro f hfr hf hfN v hv
  have hf0 : homogeneousNorm 0 f ≤ S := (homogeneousNorm_mono hf hs.le).trans_eq hfN
  obtain ⟨G, hGG⟩ := source_global_galerkin_family h41 hs.le f hfr hf
  have hG (m : ℕ) := (hGG m).1 T hT
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hl hs f hfr hf hfN hf0 G hGG (s / 2) (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hGB (m : ℕ) : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, homogeneousNorm s (G m t) ≤ A :=
    (hgal (m + 1) (by omega) f (G m) hfr hf hfN hf0
      (hG m).1 (hG m).2.1 (hG m).2.2).2
  have hconstructed : BITConstructedLimit43 s T f w :=
    ⟨s / 2, by linarith, by linarith, A, hA, G, hGG, hGB, hw⟩
  have hu := (h63.regularity s hs hs1 T hT f hfr hf w hconstructed).2
  filter_upwards [hw.2.2.1, ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc] with t ht hti
  rw [hu v hv t hti]
  exact ht

 theorem low_to_historical (h41 : BITProposition41) (h43 : BITTheorems42And43) (h63 : BITTheorem63)
    (hL : BITTheorem65) : BITLowRegularity := by
  intro s hs hs1 T hT f hfr hf v hv
  have hvweak : SourceWeakSolution T f v := by
    obtain ⟨σ, _, _, hcert⟩ := hv
    exact hcert.1
  obtain ⟨v0, hv0⟩ := original_limit_exists h41 h43 hs hT f hfr hf
  obtain ⟨hc0, hu0⟩ := h63.regularity s hs hs1 T hT f hfr hf v0 hv0
  have heq := hu0 v hvweak
  have hc := homogeneous_continuity_congr hc0 heq
  have hu : BITUniqueWeak T f v := fun w hw t ht => (hu0 w hw t ht).trans (heq t ht).symm
  have hsphere : ∀ S : ℝ, 0 < S → ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧
      ∀ f g : Fourier, RealValued f → RealValued g → InHomSobolev s f → InHomSobolev s g →
      homogeneousNorm s f = S → homogeneousNorm s g = S →
      ∀ v w : ℝ → Fourier, SourceWeakSolution T f v → SourceWeakSolution T g w →
      HomSobolevContinuousOn s T v → HomSobolevContinuousOn s T w →
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, homogeneousNorm s (v t - w t) ≤ K * homogeneousNorm s (f - g) := by
    intro S hS
    obtain ⟨A, hA, hbound⟩ := low_fixed_sphere_bound h41 h43 h63 hs hs1 hT hS
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ, C, hC, C', hC', hb⟩ := dependence67_norm_to_ae h63.dependence s hs hs1 T hT (2 * A) (by positivity)
    refine ⟨C' * (2 * C + 1) ^ (⌊T / τ⌋₊ + 1), by positivity, ?_⟩
    intro a b har hbr ha hb' haN hbN va vb hva hvb hvaC hvbC
    have hB : bitHomSup s T va + bitHomSup s T vb ≤ 2 * A := by
      have h1 := bitHomSup_le_of_ae hA va (hbound a har ha haN va hva)
      have h2 := bitHomSup_le_of_ae hA vb (hbound b hbr hb' hbN vb hvb)
      linarith
    have hh := hb a b har hbr ha hb' va vb hva hvb hvaC.essentiallyBounded hvbC.essentiallyBounded hB
    exact homogeneous_bound_of_ae hT (hvaC.sub hvbC) hh
  have hl := local_lipschitz_from_spheres hL hs hT
    (source_exists_low h41 h43 h63 hs hs1 hT) hsphere hfr hf hvweak hc
  exact ⟨hc, (fun w hw _ => hu w hw), hl⟩


theorem bit65_norm_to_historical (h : BITTheorem65Norm) : BITWeakerLipschitz := by
  intro M hM θ hθ hθ0
  obtain ⟨C, hC, A, hA, hb⟩ := h M hM θ hθ hθ0
  refine ⟨C, hC, A, hA, ?_⟩
  intro T hT f g hfr hgr hf hg hfg v w hv hw hvC hwC
  have he : HomogeneousEssentiallyBounded θ T (fun t => v t - w t) :=
    ((hvC.sub hwC).of_le hθ0).essentiallyBounded
  have hK : 0 ≤ C * A ^ T := by positivity
  exact (bitHomSup_le_iff he (mul_nonneg hK (homogeneousNorm_nonneg _ _))).mp
    (hb T hT f g hfr hgr hf hg hfg v w hv hw hvC hwC)

theorem bit65_historical_to_norm (h : BITWeakerLipschitz) : BITTheorem65Norm := by
  intro M hM θ hθ hθ0
  obtain ⟨C, hC, A, hA, hb⟩ := h M hM θ hθ hθ0
  refine ⟨C, hC, A, hA, ?_⟩
  intro T hT f g hfr hgr hf hg hfg v w hv hw hvC hwC
  have he : HomogeneousEssentiallyBounded θ T (fun t => v t - w t) :=
    ((hvC.sub hwC).of_le hθ0).essentiallyBounded
  have hK : 0 ≤ C * A ^ T := by positivity
  exact (bitHomSup_le_iff he (mul_nonneg hK (homogeneousNorm_nonneg _ _))).mpr
    (hb T hT f g hfr hgr hf hg hfg v w hv hw hvC hwC)

theorem bit65_iff_historical : BITTheorem65Norm ↔ BITWeakerLipschitz :=
  ⟨bit65_norm_to_historical, bit65_historical_to_norm⟩


/-- The all-time energy conclusion also follows for the low-regularity original
constructed flow once its published continuity conclusion is available. -/
theorem original_constructed_energy {s T : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hT : 0 < T)
    {f : Fourier} {v : ℝ → Fourier} (hv : BITConstructedLimit43 s T f v)
    (hc : HomSobolevContinuousOn s T v) :
    ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, homogeneousNorm 0 (v t) = homogeneousNorm 0 f := by
  obtain ⟨σ, _, _, A, _, G, _, _, hv⟩ := hv
  exact Measure.eqOn_Icc_of_ae_eq volume (ne_of_lt hT) hv.2.2.2.1
    (hc.of_le hs).norm_continuousOn continuousOn_const


theorem bit65_all_bounds_iff : BITTheorem65AllBounds ↔ BITTheorem65Norm := by
  constructor
  · intro h M _ θ hθ hθ0

  · intro h M θ hθ hθ0
    by_cases hM : 0 ≤ M
    · exact h M hM θ hθ hθ0
    · refine ⟨1, by norm_num, 1, by norm_num, ?_⟩
      intro T hT f g hfr hgr hf hg hfg

/-- The amplitude used to lift a radius-R ball to the radius-2R sphere is
Lipschitz. This scalar estimate controls the *difference* of the two paddings. -/
theorem sqrt_padding_lipschitz {R x y d : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hxR : x ≤ R) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hyR : y ≤ R)
    (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hxy : |x - y| ≤ d) :
    |Real.sqrt (((2 * R) ^ 2 - x ^ 2) / 2) -
      Real.sqrt (((2 * R) ^ 2 - y ^ 2) / 2)| ≤ d := by
  let a := Real.sqrt (((2 * R) ^ 2 - x ^ 2) / 2)
  let b := Real.sqrt (((2 * R) ^ 2 - y ^ 2) / 2)
  have hradx : 0 ≤ ((2 * R) ^ 2 - x ^ 2) / 2 := by nlinarith
  have hrady : 0 ≤ ((2 * R) ^ 2 - y ^ 2) / 2 := by nlinarith
  have ha : a ^ 2 = ((2 * R) ^ 2 - x ^ 2) / 2 := Real.sq_sqrt hradx
  have hb : b ^ 2 = ((2 * R) ^ 2 - y ^ 2) / 2 := Real.sq_sqrt hrady
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hb0 : 0 ≤ b := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have haR : R ≤ a := by nlinarith
  have hbR : R ≤ b := by nlinarith
  have hsum : x + y ≤ 2 * R := by linarith
  obtain ⟨hxy1, hxy2⟩ := abs_le.mp hxy
  have upper : ∀ a b x y : ℝ,
      a ^ 2 = ((2 * R) ^ 2 - x ^ 2) / 2 →
      b ^ 2 = ((2 * R) ^ 2 - y ^ 2) / 2 →
      R ≤ a → R ≤ b → 0 ≤ x + y → x + y ≤ 2 * R → y - x ≤ d → a - b ≤ d := by
    intro a b x y ha hb haR hbR hsum0 hsum hyxd
    by_cases hab : a ≤ b
    · linarith
    have hab0 : 0 ≤ a - b := by linarith
    have hm1 := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hsum) hd
    have hm2 := mul_nonneg hsum0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hyxd)
    have hm3 := mul_nonneg hab0 (show 0 ≤ a + b - 2 * R by linarith)
    have hRd : 0 ≤ R * d := mul_nonneg hR.le hd
    apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hR).mp
    nlinarith
  apply abs_le.mpr
  constructor
  · have h := upper b a y x hb ha hbR haR (by linarith) (by linarith) hxy2
    linarith
  · exact upper a b x y ha hb haR hbR (by linarith) hsum (by linarith)


open KdV

/-- The weighted sequence before homogeneous reconstruction. -/
def pairedSphereLift (p : ℤ) (R : ℝ) (F : L2Seq) : L2Seq :=
  F + symmetricSpike p (Real.sqrt (((2 * R) ^ 2 - ‖F‖ ^ 2) / 2))

theorem symmetricSpike_sub (p : ℤ) (a b : ℝ) :
    symmetricSpike p a - symmetricSpike p b = symmetricSpike p (a - b) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext k
  simp only [symmetricSpike, lp.coeFn_sub, lp.coeFn_add, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply,
    lp.single_apply, Pi.single_apply]
  split_ifs <;> push_cast <;> ring

theorem symmetricSpike_norm_le (p : ℤ) (a : ℝ) :
    ‖symmetricSpike p a‖ ≤ 2 * |a| := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖(lp.single 2 p (a : ℂ) : L2Seq)‖ + ‖(lp.single 2 (-p) (a : ℂ) : L2Seq)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = _ := by rw [lp.norm_single (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ≥0∞) < 2),
      lp.norm_single (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ≥0∞) < 2)]; simp [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]; ring

/-- A single fixed-radius sphere estimate suffices for comparison on the ball:
the simultaneous lift has a uniform bound for differences. -/
theorem pairedSphereLift_lipschitz {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (p : ℤ)
    (F G : L2Seq) (hF : ‖F‖ ≤ R) (hG : ‖G‖ ≤ R) :
    ‖pairedSphereLift p R F - pairedSphereLift p R G‖ ≤ 3 * ‖F - G‖ := by
  let a := Real.sqrt (((2 * R) ^ 2 - ‖F‖ ^ 2) / 2)
  let b := Real.sqrt (((2 * R) ^ 2 - ‖G‖ ^ 2) / 2)
  have hab : |a - b| ≤ ‖F - G‖ := sqrt_padding_lipschitz hR
    (norm_nonneg F) hF (norm_nonneg G) hG (norm_nonneg _) (abs_norm_sub_norm_le F G)
  have he : pairedSphereLift p R F - pairedSphereLift p R G =
      (F - G) + symmetricSpike p (a - b) := by
    change (F + symmetricSpike p a) - (G + symmetricSpike p b) = _
    rw [← symmetricSpike_sub p a b]
    exact add_sub_add_comm _ _ _ _
  have htri := norm_add_le (F - G) (symmetricSpike p (a - b))
  have hsp := symmetricSpike_norm_le p (a - b)
  have hsum : ‖F - G‖ + ‖symmetricSpike p (a - b)‖ ≤ ‖F - G‖ + 2 * |a - b| := by
    linarith only [hsp]
  have hfin : ‖F - G‖ + 2 * |a - b| ≤ 3 * ‖F - G‖ := by linarith only [hab]
  have hn := congrArg (fun X : L2Seq => ‖X‖) he
  exact hn.le.trans (htri.trans (hsum.trans hfin))


/-- The paired lift lies on exactly one sphere for every datum in the ball. -/
theorem pairedSphereLift_norm {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) {p : ℤ} (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (F : L2Seq) (hF : ‖F‖ ≤ R) (hFp : F p = 0) (hFm : F (-p) = 0) :
    ‖pairedSphereLift p R F‖ = 2 * R := by
  have hrad : 0 ≤ ((2 * R) ^ 2 - ‖F‖ ^ 2) / 2 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg F]
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt hrad
  have hn := norm_add_symmetricSpike_sq hp
    (Real.sqrt (((2 * R) ^ 2 - ‖F‖ ^ 2) / 2)) F hFp hFm
  change ‖pairedSphereLift p R F‖ ^ 2 = ‖F‖ ^ 2 +
    2 * Real.sqrt (((2 * R) ^ 2 - ‖F‖ ^ 2) / 2) ^ 2 at hn
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (pairedSphereLift p R F)]

theorem pairedSphereLift_coeff {p k : ℤ} (hkp : k ≠ p) (hkm : k ≠ -p)
    (R : ℝ) (F : L2Seq) : pairedSphereLift p R F k = F k := by
  simp [pairedSphereLift, symmetricSpike, lp.single_apply, Ne.symm hkp, Ne.symm hkm]


/-- Actual homogeneous data with the paired high-frequency lift. -/
def sourceSphereData (s R : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (f : Fourier) (hf : InHomSobolev s f) : Fourier :=
  homogeneousReconstruct s (pairedSphereLift ((m : ℤ) + 1) R
    (homogeneousLp s (cutoff m f) (hf.cutoff m)))

theorem sourceSphereData_properties {s R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (m : ℕ)
    (f : Fourier) (hf : InHomSobolev s f) (hfr : RealValued f)
    (hfR : homogeneousNorm s f ≤ R) :
    RealValued (sourceSphereData s R m f hf) ∧
    InHomSobolev s (sourceSphereData s R m f hf) ∧
    homogeneousNorm s (sourceSphereData s R m f hf) = 2 * R ∧
    cutoff m (sourceSphereData s R m f hf) = cutoff m f := by
  let p : ℤ := (m : ℤ) + 1
  let F := homogeneousLp s (cutoff m f) (hf.cutoff m)
  let Q := pairedSphereLift p R F
  have hp : p ≠ 0 := by dsimp [p]; omega
  have hpo : p ∉ Finset.Icc (-(m : ℤ)) (m : ℤ) := by simp [p]
  have hmo : -p ∉ Finset.Icc (-(m : ℤ)) (m : ℤ) := by simp [p]
  have hFp : F p = 0 := by
    change homogeneousWeighted s (cutoff m f) p = 0
    rw [homogeneousWeighted_cutoff]
    simp [cutoff, hpo]
  have hFm : F (-p) = 0 := by
    change homogeneousWeighted s (cutoff m f) (-p) = 0
    rw [homogeneousWeighted_cutoff]
    simp [cutoff, hmo]
  have hF0 : F 0 = 0 := by
    change (homogeneousWeight s 0 : ℂ) * cutoff m f 0 = 0
    rw [cutoff_meanZero hf.1 m, mul_zero]
  have hQ0 : Q 0 = 0 := by
    change F 0 + symmetricSpike p _ 0 = 0
    rw [hF0, symmetricSpike_zero hp, add_zero]
  have hQr : RealValued Q.val :=
    (homogeneousWeighted_real s (cutoff_real hfr m)).add (symmetricSpike_real p _)
  have hFN : ‖F‖ ≤ R := by
    rw [homogeneousLp_norm]
    exact (homogeneousNorm_cutoff_le hf m).trans hfR
  refine ⟨homogeneousReconstruct_real s Q hQr,
    homogeneousReconstruct_inHomSobolev s Q hQ0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change homogeneousNorm s (homogeneousReconstruct s Q) = _
    rw [homogeneousReconstruct_norm s Q hQ0]
    exact pairedSphereLift_norm hR hp F hFN hFp hFm
  · funext k
    by_cases hki : k ∈ Finset.Icc (-(m : ℤ)) (m : ℤ)
    · simp only [cutoff, if_pos hki]
      by_cases hk : k = 0
      · subst k
        have hf0 : f 0 = 0 := hf.1
        simp [sourceSphereData, homogeneousReconstruct, hf0]
      · have hkp : k ≠ p := by intro he; subst k; exact hpo hki
        have hkm : k ≠ -p := by intro he; subst k; exact hmo hki
        have hQk : Q k = (homogeneousWeight s k : ℂ) * f k := by
          rw [pairedSphereLift_coeff hkp hkm]
          change (homogeneousWeight s k : ℂ) * cutoff m f k = _
          simp [cutoff, hki]
        change (if k = 0 then 0 else (homogeneousWeight s k : ℂ)⁻¹ * Q k) = f k
        rw [if_neg hk, hQk, ← mul_assoc,
          inv_mul_cancel₀ (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (homogeneousWeight_pos_of_ne_zero s hk).ne'), one_mul]
    · simp [cutoff, hki]


theorem homogeneousReconstruct_sub (s : ℝ) (F G : L2Seq) :
    homogeneousReconstruct s (F - G) = homogeneousReconstruct s F - homogeneousReconstruct s G := by
  funext k
  by_cases hk : k = 0 <;> simp [homogeneousReconstruct, hk, mul_sub]

theorem sourceSphereData_difference {s R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (m : ℕ)
    (f g : Fourier) (hf : InHomSobolev s f) (hg : InHomSobolev s g)
    (hfR : homogeneousNorm s f ≤ R) (hgR : homogeneousNorm s g ≤ R) :
    homogeneousNorm s (sourceSphereData s R m f hf - sourceSphereData s R m g hg) ≤
      3 * homogeneousNorm s (f - g) := by
  let p : ℤ := (m : ℤ) + 1
  let F := homogeneousLp s (cutoff m f) (hf.cutoff m)
  let G := homogeneousLp s (cutoff m g) (hg.cutoff m)
  let QF := pairedSphereLift p R F
  let QG := pairedSphereLift p R G
  have hp : p ≠ 0 := by dsimp [p]; omega
  have hQ0 (H : L2Seq) (hH : H 0 = 0) : pairedSphereLift p R H 0 = 0 := by
    change H 0 + symmetricSpike p _ 0 = 0
    rw [hH, symmetricSpike_zero hp, add_zero]
  have hF0 : F 0 = 0 := by
    change (homogeneousWeight s 0 : ℂ) * cutoff m f 0 = 0
    rw [cutoff_meanZero hf.1, mul_zero]
  have hG0 : G 0 = 0 := by
    change (homogeneousWeight s 0 : ℂ) * cutoff m g 0 = 0
    rw [cutoff_meanZero hg.1, mul_zero]
  have hD0 : (QF - QG) 0 = 0 := by
    change QF 0 - QG 0 = 0
    rw [hQ0 F hF0, hQ0 G hG0, sub_self]
  have hFN : ‖F‖ ≤ R := by
    rw [homogeneousLp_norm]
    exact (homogeneousNorm_cutoff_le hf m).trans hfR
  have hGN : ‖G‖ ≤ R := by
    rw [homogeneousLp_norm]
    exact (homogeneousNorm_cutoff_le hg m).trans hgR
  have hDiff : F - G = homogeneousLp s (cutoff m (f - g)) ((hf.sub hg).cutoff m) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change homogeneousWeighted s (cutoff m f) - homogeneousWeighted s (cutoff m g) = _
    rw [← homogeneousWeighted_sub, ← cutoff_sub]
    rfl
  have hNormDiff : ‖F - G‖ ≤ homogeneousNorm s (f - g) := by
    rw [hDiff, homogeneousLp_norm]
    exact homogeneousNorm_cutoff_le (hf.sub hg) m
  change homogeneousNorm s (homogeneousReconstruct s QF - homogeneousReconstruct s QG) ≤ _
  rw [← homogeneousReconstruct_sub, homogeneousReconstruct_norm s (QF - QG) hD0]
  have hb := pairedSphereLift_lipschitz hR p F G hFN hGN
  exact hb.trans (by linarith only [hNormDiff])


theorem negative_weight_tendsto_zero {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => weight (-s) (n : ℤ)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
  have hb : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 1 + (n : ℝ) ^ 2) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
    apply Filter.tendsto_atTop_mono (f := fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ))
    · intro n
      have hn : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((n : ℝ) - 1 / 2)]
    · exact tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have hw := (tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop (show 0 < s / 2 by linarith)).comp hb
  simpa [weight, neg_div, Function.comp_def] using hw

/-- Padding at frequencies escaping to infinity disappears in L2 for every
strictly positive Sobolev exponent, even though its H^s size stays fixed. -/
theorem sourceSphereData_L2_converges {s R : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hR : 0 < R)
    (f : Fourier) (hf : InHomSobolev s f) (hfr : RealValued f)
    (hfR : homogeneousNorm s f ≤ R) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => homogeneousNorm 0 (sourceSphereData s R n f hf - f))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
  let D : ℕ → Fourier := fun n => sourceSphereData s R n f hf - f
  let C : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ s * (3 * R)
  have hb (n : ℕ) : hNorm 0 (D n) ≤ weight (-s) (n : ℤ) * C := by
    obtain ⟨_, hpad, hnorm, hlow⟩ := sourceSphereData_properties hR n f hf hfr hfR
    have hD : InHomSobolev s (D n) := hpad.sub hf
    have hcut : cutoff n (D n) = 0 := by
      change cutoff n (sourceSphereData s R n f hf - f) = 0
      rw [cutoff_sub, hlow, sub_self]
    have hhigh : highCutoff n (D n) = D n := by simp [highCutoff, hcut]
    have hHs : hNorm s (D n) ≤ C := by
      have hd := homogeneousNorm_sub_le hpad hf
      change homogeneousNorm s (D n) ≤ _ at hd
      have hbd : homogeneousNorm s (D n) ≤ 3 * R := by rw [hnorm] at hd; linarith
      exact (hNorm_le_homogeneousNorm hs.le hD).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbd (Real.rpow_nonneg (by norm_num) _))
    have hh := (high_cutoff_bound hs.le (hD.to_inhomogeneous hs.le) n).2
    rw [hhigh] at hh
    simp only [zero_sub] at hh
    exact hh.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hHs (weight_pos _ _).le)
  have hw := (negative_weight_tendsto_zero hs).mul_const C
  have he := squeeze_zero (fun n => hNorm_nonneg 0 (D n)) hb (by simpa using hw)
  simpa only [homogeneousNorm_zero] using he

/-- The genuine source weaker-norm estimate turns L2 convergence of data into
coefficient convergence of their continuous source flows. -/
theorem source_flow_coefficient_limit (hL : BITWeakerLipschitz)
    {T M : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    {data : ℕ → Fourier} {f : Fourier} {flows : ℕ → ℝ → Fourier} {v : ℝ → Fourier}
    (hdataR : ∀ n, RealValued (data n)) (hfR : RealValued f)
    (hdata : ∀ n, InHomSobolev 0 (data n)) (hf : InHomSobolev 0 f)
    (hbound : ∀ n, homogeneousNorm 0 (data n) + homogeneousNorm 0 f ≤ M)
    (hflows : ∀ n, SourceWeakSolution T (data n) (flows n))
    (hflowsC : ∀ n, HomSobolevContinuousOn 0 T (flows n))
    (hv : SourceWeakSolution T f v) (hvC : HomSobolevContinuousOn 0 T v)
    (hd : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => homogeneousNorm 0 (data n - f)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) :
    ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, ∀ k : ℤ,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => flows n t k) Filter.atTop (nhds (v t k)) := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, A, hA, hb⟩ := source_flow_lipschitz hL hM
    (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) < 0) (le_refl (0 : ℝ))
  intro t ht k
  have hcoeff (n : ℕ) : ‖flows n t k - v t k‖ ≤
      (C * A ^ T) * homogeneousNorm 0 (data n - f) := by
    have hdiff : InSobolev 0 (flows n t - v t) :=
      (((hflowsC n).1 t ht).sub (hvC.1 t ht)).to_inhomogeneous (le_refl 0)
    have hc : ‖flows n t k - v t k‖ ≤ homogeneousNorm 0 (flows n t - v t) := by
      simpa only [homogeneousNorm_zero, weighted_zero, Pi.sub_apply] using weighted_coeff_bound hdiff k
    exact hc.trans (hb T hT (data n) f (hdataR n) hfR (hdata n) hf (hbound n)
      (flows n) v (hflows n) hv (hflowsC n) hvC t ht)
  rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
  apply squeeze_zero (fun n => norm_nonneg _) hcoeff
  simpa using hd.const_mul (C * A ^ T)


/-- Project-specific consequence: estimates with constants only on exact norm
spheres imply the historical neighborhood estimate. All flow and estimate
hypotheses are explicit here; none is asserted as a literature theorem. -/
theorem local_lipschitz_from_spheres (hL : BITWeakerLipschitz)
    {s T : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hexists : ∀ f : Fourier, RealValued f → InHomSobolev s f →
      ∃ v : ℝ → Fourier, SourceWeakSolution T f v ∧ HomSobolevContinuousOn s T v)
    (hsphere : ∀ S : ℝ, 0 < S → ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧
      ∀ f g : Fourier, RealValued f → RealValued g → InHomSobolev s f → InHomSobolev s g →
      homogeneousNorm s f = S → homogeneousNorm s g = S →
      ∀ v w : ℝ → Fourier, SourceWeakSolution T f v → SourceWeakSolution T g w →
      HomSobolevContinuousOn s T v → HomSobolevContinuousOn s T w →
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, homogeneousNorm s (v t - w t) ≤ K * homogeneousNorm s (f - g))
    {f : Fourier} (hfr : RealValued f) (hf : InHomSobolev s f)
    {v : ℝ → Fourier} (hv : SourceWeakSolution T f v) (hvC : HomSobolevContinuousOn s T v) :
    SourceLocalLipschitz s T f v := by
  let R := homogeneousNorm s f + 1
  have hR : 0 < R := by dsimp [R]; have := homogeneousNorm_nonneg s f; linarith
  have hfR : homogeneousNorm s f ≤ R := by dsimp [R]; linarith
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hb⟩ := hsphere (2 * R) (by positivity)
  apply (source_local_lipschitz_iff hT hvC).mp
  refine ⟨1, by norm_num, 3 * K, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro g hgr hg hgf w hw hwC
  have hgR : homogeneousNorm s g ≤ R := by
    have hh := (abs_le.mp (abs_homogeneousNorm_sub_le hg hf)).2
    dsimp [R]
    linarith
  let F := fun n => sourceSphereData s R n f hf
  let G := fun n => sourceSphereData s R n g hg
  have hFP (n : ℕ) := sourceSphereData_properties hR n f hf hfr hfR
  have hGP (n : ℕ) := sourceSphereData_properties hR n g hg hgr hgR
  choose vf hvf hvfC using (fun n : ℕ => hexists (F n) (hFP n).1 (hFP n).2.1)
  choose wg hwg hwgC using (fun n : ℕ => hexists (G n) (hGP n).1 (hGP n).2.1)
  have hf0 : InHomSobolev 0 f := hf.of_le hs.le
  have hg0 : InHomSobolev 0 g := hg.of_le hs.le
  have hF0 (n : ℕ) : InHomSobolev 0 (F n) := (hFP n).2.1.of_le hs.le
  have hG0 (n : ℕ) : InHomSobolev 0 (G n) := (hGP n).2.1.of_le hs.le
  have hbf (n : ℕ) : homogeneousNorm 0 (F n) + homogeneousNorm 0 f ≤ 4 * R := by
    have h1 := homogeneousNorm_mono (hFP n).2.1 hs.le
    have h2 := homogeneousNorm_mono hf hs.le
    rw [(hFP n).2.2.1] at h1
    linarith
  have hbg (n : ℕ) : homogeneousNorm 0 (G n) + homogeneousNorm 0 g ≤ 4 * R := by
    have h1 := homogeneousNorm_mono (hGP n).2.1 hs.le
    have h2 := homogeneousNorm_mono hg hs.le
    rw [(hGP n).2.2.1] at h1
    linarith
  have hcv := source_flow_coefficient_limit hL hT (show 0 ≤ 4 * R by positivity)
    (fun n => (hFP n).1) hfr hF0 hf0 hbf hvf (fun n => (hvfC n).of_le hs.le)
    hv (hvC.of_le hs.le) (sourceSphereData_L2_converges hs hR f hf hfr hfR)
  have hcw := source_flow_coefficient_limit hL hT (show 0 ≤ 4 * R by positivity)
    (fun n => (hGP n).1) hgr hG0 hg0 hbg hwg (fun n => (hwgC n).of_le hs.le)
    hw (hwC.of_le hs.le) (sourceSphereData_L2_converges hs hR g hg hgr hgR)
  intro t ht
  have hbound (n : ℕ) : homogeneousNorm s (vf n t - wg n t) ≤
      (3 * K) * homogeneousNorm s (f - g) := by
    have hh := hb (F n) (G n) (hFP n).1 (hGP n).1 (hFP n).2.1 (hGP n).2.1
      (hFP n).2.2.1 (hGP n).2.2.1 (vf n) (wg n) (hvf n) (hwg n) (hvfC n) (hwgC n) t ht
    have hp := sourceSphereData_difference hR n f g hf hg hfR hgR
    have hh2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp hK.le
    exact hh.trans (by nlinarith only [hh2])
  have hA : 0 ≤ (3 * K) * homogeneousNorm s (f - g) :=
    mul_nonneg (by positivity) (homogeneousNorm_nonneg _ _)
  exact (homogeneous_norm_limit hA
    (fun n => ((hvfC n).1 t ht).sub ((hwgC n).1 t ht)) hbound
    (fun k => (hcv t ht k).sub (hcw t ht k))).2

end BareModelCompletion

import Mathlib

/-!
Formal development of Theorem 1 of the supplied paper.
The exported `theorem_1` proves the uniform error bound conditional on the cited
external parameters. Smooth approximation, existence and the distributional
Sobolev representation are proved internally.
The raw coefficient model is used to retain every integer Fourier mode.
-/

noncomputable section

open scoped ComplexConjugate ENNReal
open MeasureTheory

namespace KdV

abbrev Fourier := ℤ → ℂ

/-- The paper's torus, with period exactly `2π`. -/
abbrev Torus := AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)

instance periodPositive : Fact (0 < 2 * Real.pi) := ⟨by positivity⟩

/-- Normalized measure, of total mass one. -/
def normalizedMeasure : Measure Torus := AddCircle.haarAddCircle

instance : IsProbabilityMeasure normalizedMeasure := by
  unfold normalizedMeasure
  infer_instance

/-- `(1+k²)^(s/2)`, the square root of the Sobolev norm weight. -/
def weight (s : ℝ) (k : ℤ) : ℝ := (1 + (k : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ (s / 2)

theorem weight_pos (s : ℝ) (k : ℤ) : 0 < weight s k := by
  unfold weight
  positivity

@[simp] theorem weight_zero (k : ℤ) : weight 0 k = 1 := by simp [weight]

def weighted (s : ℝ) (f : Fourier) : Fourier := fun k => (weight s k : ℂ) * f k

@[simp] theorem weighted_zero (f : Fourier) : weighted 0 f = f := by
  funext k
  simp [weighted]

/-- Weighted square summability; no restriction on Fourier support. -/
def InSobolev (s : ℝ) (f : Fourier) : Prop := Memℓp (weighted s f) 2

@[simp] theorem weighted_add (s : ℝ) (f g : Fourier) :
    weighted s (f + g) = weighted s f + weighted s g := by
  funext k
  simp [weighted, mul_add]

@[simp] theorem weighted_sub (s : ℝ) (f g : Fourier) :
    weighted s (f - g) = weighted s f - weighted s g := by
  funext k
  simp [weighted, mul_sub]

@[simp] theorem weighted_smul (s : ℝ) (z : ℂ) (f : Fourier) :
    weighted s (z • f) = z • weighted s f := by
  funext k
  simp [weighted, mul_left_comm]

theorem InSobolev.add {s : ℝ} {f g : Fourier} (hf : InSobolev s f)
    (hg : InSobolev s g) : InSobolev s (f + g) := by
  unfold InSobolev at *
  rw [weighted_add]
  exact hf.add hg

theorem InSobolev.sub {s : ℝ} {f g : Fourier} (hf : InSobolev s f)
    (hg : InSobolev s g) : InSobolev s (f - g) := by
  unfold InSobolev at *
  rw [weighted_sub]
  exact hf.sub hg

theorem InSobolev.smul {s : ℝ} {f : Fourier} (hf : InSobolev s f)
    (z : ℂ) : InSobolev s (z • f) := by
  unfold InSobolev at *
  rw [weighted_smul]
  exact hf.const_smul z

def sobolevSubmodule (s : ℝ) : Submodule ℂ Fourier where
  carrier := InSobolev s
  zero_mem' := by
    change Memℓp (weighted s (0 : Fourier)) 2
    rw [show weighted s (0 : Fourier) = 0 by funext k; simp [weighted]]
    exact zero_memℓp
  add_mem' := InSobolev.add
  smul_mem' z _ hf := hf.smul z

/-- Weighted square-summable Fourier coefficients, with the Sobolev index kept
as a structure parameter. This avoids any inherited pointwise topology. -/
structure Sobolev (s : ℝ) where
  val : Fourier
  property : InSobolev s val

@[ext] theorem Sobolev.ext {s : ℝ} {f g : Sobolev s} (h : f.val = g.val) : f = g := by
  cases f
  cases g
  cases h
  rfl

def sobolevUnderlying (s : ℝ) : Sobolev s ≃ ↥(sobolevSubmodule s) where
  toFun f := ⟨f.val, f.property⟩
  invFun f := ⟨f.val, f.property⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

instance (s : ℝ) : AddCommGroup (Sobolev s) := (sobolevUnderlying s).addCommGroup

instance (s : ℝ) : Module ℂ (Sobolev s) := (sobolevUnderlying s).module ℂ

instance (s : ℝ) : CoeFun (Sobolev s) (fun _ => ℤ → ℂ) := ⟨fun f => f.val⟩

/-- Every weighted square-summable coefficient sequence is a genuine Hilbert-space
element; this equivalence will also transport the complete norm topology. -/
def sobolevEquiv (s : ℝ) : Sobolev s ≃ₗ[ℂ] lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 where
  toFun f := ⟨weighted s f.val, f.property⟩
  invFun g := ⟨fun k => (weight s k : ℂ)⁻¹ * g k, by
    change Memℓp (weighted s (fun k => (weight s k : ℂ)⁻¹ * g k)) 2
    have h : weighted s (fun k => (weight s k : ℂ)⁻¹ * g k) = g := by
      funext k
      simp [KdV.weighted, (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (weight_pos s k).ne')]
    rw [h]
    exact g.property⟩
  left_inv f := by
    apply Sobolev.ext
    funext k
    simp [KdV.weighted, (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (weight_pos s k).ne')]
  right_inv g := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext k
    simp [KdV.weighted, (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (weight_pos s k).ne')]
  map_add' f g := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact weighted_add s f.val g.val
  map_smul' z f := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact weighted_smul s z f.val

instance sobolevNormedAddCommGroup (s : ℝ) : NormedAddCommGroup (Sobolev s) :=
  NormedAddCommGroup.induced _ _ (sobolevEquiv s).toAddMonoidHom (sobolevEquiv s).injective

instance sobolevNormedSpace (s : ℝ) : NormedSpace ℂ (Sobolev s) where
  norm_smul_le z f := by
    change ‖sobolevEquiv s (z • f)‖ ≤ ‖z‖ * ‖sobolevEquiv s f‖
    rw [map_smul, norm_smul]

def sobolevIsometry (s : ℝ) : Sobolev s ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 :=
  { sobolevEquiv s with norm_map' := fun _ => rfl }

instance sobolevCompleteSpace (s : ℝ) : CompleteSpace (Sobolev s) :=
  (sobolevIsometry s).toIsometryEquiv.completeSpace


/-- The norm is only used as a Sobolev norm when `InSobolev s f` is established. -/
def hNorm (s : ℝ) (f : Fourier) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (∑' k : ℤ, ‖weighted s f k‖ ^ 2)

theorem hNorm_nonneg (s : ℝ) (f : Fourier) : 0 ≤ hNorm s f := Real.sqrt_nonneg _

theorem hNorm_eq_lpNorm {s : ℝ} {f : Fourier} (hf : InSobolev s f) :
    hNorm s f = ‖(⟨weighted s f, hf⟩ : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2)‖ := by
  rw [lp.norm_eq_tsum_rpow (by norm_num : 0 < (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal)]
  simp [hNorm, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]

theorem sobolev_norm {s : ℝ} (f : Sobolev s) : ‖f‖ = hNorm s f.val :=
  (hNorm_eq_lpNorm f.property).symm

theorem weight_sq (s : ℝ) (k : ℤ) : weight s k ^ 2 = (1 + (k : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ s := by
  unfold weight
  rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity : 0 ≤ 1 + (k : ℝ) ^ 2)]
  congr 1
  norm_num

theorem norm_weighted (s : ℝ) (f : Fourier) (k : ℤ) :

  simp [KdV.weighted, Complex.norm_real, abs_of_pos (weight_pos s k)]

  congr 1
  funext k
  rw [norm_weighted, mul_pow, weight_sq]

  rw [weighted_zero]

  fourierBasis.repr.symm ⟨f.val, (inSobolev_zero_iff f.val).mp f.property⟩

  refine h.symm.trans ?_
  change (fourierBasis.repr (fourierBasis.repr.symm
    ⟨f.val, (inSobolev_zero_iff f.val).mp f.property⟩)) k = f.val k
  simp only [LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

  rw [hNorm_eq_lpNorm f.property]

  rw [fourier_coe_apply]
  congr 1

  rw [fourierCoeff_eq_intervalIntegral f k 0]

                                Kaiwen Jin

                                       Abstract

         Li and Wu proved that their unfiltered integrator for periodic KdV converges in L2 with
      error O(τ γ log(1/τ)) for real, mean-zero Hγ data, 0 < γ ≤1. We remove the logarithmic factor
       for the same time-semidiscrete algorithm, with constants uniform on bounded Hγ sets. The
     main estimate concerns the exact averaged cubic remainder. Retaining both ratios of its two
       oscillatory phases bounds the dual four-frequency multiplier by the reciprocal of the third largest
      frequency. A dyadic four-linear estimate sums this majorant without a logarithm and includes
     a mixed L2 endpoint. That endpoint controls the remainder at the numerical state without a
      numerical Sobolev bound. We then prove the full global estimate using the continuous trilinear
     bounds of Li and Wu, a stepwise residual calculation, low–high frequency stability, a restarted
      bootstrap, and density. Finite Fourier experiments check the implemented update, the remainder,
     and accumulated step defects.

1  Introduction

Low spatial regularity limits the accuracy of time discretizations for dispersive equations. For
periodic KdV, differentiation in the quadratic nonlinearity makes a direct L2 perturbation estimate
insufficient. The unfiltered method of Li and Wu integrates the leading oscillatory interactions
explicitly and treats its numerical trajectory as a perturbed KdV solution. Their convergence
theorem gives Cτ γ log(1/τ) in L2 for Hγ data with 0 < γ ≤1 [1, Theorem 1.1]. The necessity of the
logarithm is left open in [1, Section 11]; this is the fixed-scheme question in AIM problem 518 [3].

Its multiplier contains the covariance of two exponential phases. Each phase can be integrated
against the other, giving two ratio bounds. Keeping their minimum matters when the output
frequency is small. After duality the four frequencies sum to zero, their largest two magnitudes
are comparable, and the remaining multiplier is controlled by 1/N3, where N3 is the third largest
magnitude. The smaller dyadic scales then carry a summable geometric factor.

and its forcing term is estimated from the actual stepwise residual. A fixed-timestep approximation
argument then removes the temporary smoothness used in the calculations.

independently checked reference resolutions. They illustrate the remainder and error accumulation.

def RealValued (f : Fourier) : Prop := ∀ k, f (-k) = conj (f k)
def MeanZero (f : Fourier) : Prop := f 0 = 0

/-- Fourier multiplication is full convolution, never cyclic convolution. -/
def product (f g : Fourier) : Fourier := fun k => ∑' a : ℤ, f a * g (k - a)

def mean (f : Fourier) : ℂ := f 0
def removeMean (f : Fourier) : Fourier := fun k => if k = 0 then 0 else f k

/-- `S_t = exp(-t ∂ₓ³)`, with multiplier `exp(i t k³)`. -/
def airy (t : ℝ) (f : Fourier) : Fourier :=
  fun k => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (t : ℂ) * (k : ℂ) ^ 3) * f k

/-- `∂ₓ⁻¹`, set to zero on the zero mode. -/
def inverseDerivative (f : Fourier) : Fourier :=
  fun k => if k = 0 then 0 else (Complex.I * (k : ℂ))⁻¹ * f k

def inverseDerivative₂ (f : Fourier) : Fourier :=
  inverseDerivative (inverseDerivative f)

/-- Exactly the quadratic correction in Section 2, equation (2). -/
def quadratic (τ : ℝ) (f : Fourier) : Fourier :=
  (1 / 6 : ℂ) • removeMean (product (airy τ (inverseDerivative f))
    (airy τ (inverseDerivative f))) -
  (1 / 6 : ℂ) • airy τ (removeMean (product (inverseDerivative f) (inverseDerivative f)))

/-- The expression evaluated at the two endpoints in the third term of `H_τ`. -/
def cubicBoundary (τ s : ℝ) (f : Fourier) : Fourier :=
  let a := airy s (inverseDerivative f)
  airy (τ - s) (inverseDerivative (product (product a a) a))

/-- The expression evaluated at the two endpoints in the fourth term of `H_τ`. -/
def lastBoundary (τ s : ℝ) (f : Fourier) : Fourier :=
  airy (τ - s) (inverseDerivative₂
    (product (airy (s - τ) (inverseDerivative₂ (quadratic τ f)))
      (airy s (inverseDerivative f))))

/-- All four terms of `H_τ`, including the `1/(27τ)` correction. -/
def cubicCorrection (τ : ℝ) (f : Fourier) : Fourier :=
  (1 / 3 : ℂ) • removeMean
    (product (airy τ (inverseDerivative f)) (inverseDerivative (quadratic τ f))) +
  ((τ : ℂ) / 9 * mean (product f f)) • airy τ (inverseDerivative f) -
  (1 / 54 : ℂ) • (cubicBoundary τ τ f - cubicBoundary τ 0 f) -
  (1 / (27 * (τ : ℂ))) • (lastBoundary τ τ f - lastBoundary τ 0 f)

def step (τ : ℝ) (f : Fourier) : Fourier :=
  airy τ f + quadratic τ f + cubicCorrection τ f

/-- The fixed, unfiltered, time-semidiscrete method for every natural step index. -/
def numerical (τ : ℝ) (f : Fourier) : ℕ → Fourier
  | 0 => f
  | n + 1 => step τ (numerical τ f n)

@[simp] theorem numerical_zero (τ : ℝ) (f : Fourier) : numerical τ f 0 = f := rfl

@[simp] theorem numerical_succ (τ : ℝ) (f : Fourier) (n : ℕ) :
    numerical τ f (n + 1) = step τ (numerical τ f n) := rfl

@[simp] theorem airy_zero (f : Fourier) : airy 0 f = f := by
  ext k
  simp [airy]

@[simp] theorem airy_mean (t : ℝ) (f : Fourier) : airy t f 0 = f 0 := by simp [airy]

theorem airy_multiplier_norm (t : ℝ) (k : ℤ) :
    ‖Complex.exp (Complex.I * (t : ℂ) * (k : ℂ) ^ 3)‖ = 1 := by
  simp [Complex.norm_exp, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, pow_succ]

theorem norm_weighted_airy (s t : ℝ) (f : Fourier) (k : ℤ) :
    ‖weighted s (airy t f) k‖ = ‖weighted s f k‖ := by
  simp [norm_weighted, airy, airy_multiplier_norm]

theorem airy_inSobolev {s : ℝ} {f : Fourier} (hf : InSobolev s f) (t : ℝ) :
    InSobolev s (airy t f) := by
  apply Memℓp.mono' hf
  intro k
  exact le_of_eq (norm_weighted_airy s t f k)

theorem airy_hNorm (s t : ℝ) (f : Fourier) : hNorm s (airy t f) = hNorm s f := by
  simp [hNorm, norm_weighted_airy]

@[simp] theorem removeMean_zero (f : Fourier) : removeMean f 0 = 0 := by simp [removeMean]

@[simp] theorem inverseDerivative_zero (f : Fourier) : inverseDerivative f 0 = 0 := by
  simp [inverseDerivative]

@[simp] theorem inverseDerivative₂_zero (f : Fourier) : inverseDerivative₂ f 0 = 0 := by
  simp [inverseDerivative₂]

theorem quadratic_meanZero (τ : ℝ) (f : Fourier) : MeanZero (quadratic τ f) := by
  simp [MeanZero, quadratic]

theorem cubicCorrection_meanZero (τ : ℝ) (f : Fourier) : MeanZero (cubicCorrection τ f) := by
  simp [MeanZero, cubicCorrection, cubicBoundary, lastBoundary]

theorem step_meanZero (τ : ℝ) {f : Fourier} (hf : MeanZero f) : MeanZero (step τ f) := by
  change airy τ f 0 + quadratic τ f 0 + cubicCorrection τ f 0 = 0
  rw [airy_mean, quadratic_meanZero τ f, cubicCorrection_meanZero τ f, hf]
  simp

theorem numerical_meanZero (τ : ℝ) {f : Fourier} (hf : MeanZero f) (n : ℕ) :
    MeanZero (numerical τ f n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hf
  | succ n ih => exact step_meanZero τ ih

/-- The exact oscillatory covariance, including its normalization by `τ`. -/
def phaseAverage (τ α : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  (τ : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∫ s : ℝ in (0 : ℝ)..τ, Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (s : ℂ) * (α : ℂ))

def covariance (τ α β : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  phaseAverage τ (α + β) - phaseAverage τ α * phaseAverage τ β

theorem phaseAverage_zero {τ : ℝ} (hτ : τ ≠ 0) : phaseAverage τ 0 = 1 := by
  simp [phaseAverage, Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hτ]

@[simp] theorem covariance_zero_left {τ : ℝ} (hτ : τ ≠ 0) (β : ℝ) :
    covariance τ 0 β = 0 := by
  simp [covariance, phaseAverage_zero hτ]

@[simp] theorem covariance_zero_right {τ : ℝ} (hτ : τ ≠ 0) (α : ℝ) :
    covariance τ α 0 = 0 := by
  simp [covariance, phaseAverage_zero hτ]

theorem covariance_comm (τ α β : ℝ) : covariance τ α β = covariance τ β α := by
  simp [covariance, add_comm, mul_comm]

theorem phase_identity (a b c : ℤ) :
    3 * a * b * (a + b) + 3 * (a + b + c) * c * (a + b) =
      (a + b + c) ^ 3 - a ^ 3 - b ^ 3 - c ^ 3 := by ring

/-- The entire cubic averaging remainder (4), represented without a cutoff. -/
def remainder (τ t : ℝ) (f₁ f₂ f₃ : Fourier) : Fourier := fun k =>
  if k = 0 then 0 else
    (-(τ : ℂ) / (18 * Complex.I * (k : ℂ))) *
      ∑' ab : ℤ × ℤ,
        let a := ab.1
        let b := ab.2
        let c := k - a - b
        let p := a + b
        let α : ℝ := 3 * (a : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)
        let β : ℝ := 3 * (k : ℝ) * (c : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)
        let Φ : ℤ := k ^ 3 - a ^ 3 - b ^ 3 - c ^ 3
        if p = 0 then 0 else
          Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (t : ℂ) * (Φ : ℂ)) * covariance τ α β *
            f₁ a * f₂ b * f₃ c

theorem remainder_meanZero (τ t : ℝ) (f₁ f₂ f₃ : Fourier) :
    MeanZero (remainder τ t f₁ f₂ f₃) := by simp [MeanZero, remainder]

/-- Norm continuity of a coefficient-valued path in the specified Sobolev space. -/
def SobolevContinuousOn (s T : ℝ) (u : ℝ → Fourier) : Prop :=
  (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, InSobolev s (u t)) ∧
    ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 T,
        |r - t| < δ → hNorm s (u r - u t) < ε

/-- Fourier Duhamel equation for `u_t + u_xxx = ∂ₓ(u²)/2`.
Its distributional Sobolev realization is proved below. -/
def Duhamel (T : ℝ) (u₀ : Fourier) (u : ℝ → Fourier) : Prop :=
  u 0 = u₀ ∧ ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, ∀ k : ℤ,
    u t k = airy t u₀ k +
      (1 / 2 : ℂ) * ∫ s : ℝ in (0 : ℝ)..t,
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((t - s) : ℂ) * (k : ℂ) ^ 3) *
          (Complex.I * (k : ℂ)) * product (u s) (u s) k

def KdVSolution (γ T : ℝ) (u₀ : Fourier) (u : ℝ → Fourier) : Prop :=
  SobolevContinuousOn γ T u ∧ Duhamel T u₀ u ∧
    ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, RealValued (u t) ∧ MeanZero (u t)

def SmoothSolution (T : ℝ) (u₀ : Fourier) (u : ℝ → Fourier) : Prop :=
  Duhamel T u₀ u ∧ (∀ s : ℝ, SobolevContinuousOn s T u) ∧
    (∀ k : ℤ, ∀ m : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ m (fun t => u t k) (Set.Icc 0 T)) ∧
    ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, RealValued (u t) ∧ MeanZero (u t)

/-- Smooth approximation in the initial Sobolev norm and uniformly in solution `L²`.
This is part of the solution concept, not an assumed error estimate for the method. -/
def ObtainedBySmoothApproximation (γ T : ℝ) (u₀ : Fourier) (u : ℝ → Fourier) : Prop :=
  ∃ data : ℕ → Fourier, ∃ solutions : ℕ → ℝ → Fourier,
    (∀ m, SmoothSolution T (data m) (solutions m)) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto (fun m => hNorm γ (data m - u₀)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ m₀ : ℕ, ∀ m ≥ m₀,
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, hNorm 0 (solutions m t - u t) < ε

def ExactSolution (γ T : ℝ) (u₀ : Fourier) (u : ℝ → Fourier) : Prop :=
  KdVSolution γ T u₀ u ∧ ObtainedBySmoothApproximation γ T u₀ u

/-- A literal maximum over all `L+1` grid points, including both endpoints. -/
def maximumError (T : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (u₀ : Fourier) (u : ℝ → Fourier) : ℝ :=
  (Finset.range (L + 1)).sup' (by simp) fun n =>
    hNorm 0 (u ((n : ℝ) * (T / (L : ℝ))) - numerical (T / (L : ℝ)) u₀ n)

/-- The target quantifiers. This definition asserts no theorem or premise. -/
def TheoremOne : Prop :=
  ∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T → ∀ γ : ℝ, 0 < γ → γ ≤ 1 → ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R →
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ τ₀ : ℝ, 0 < τ₀ ∧
      ∀ u₀ : Fourier, InSobolev γ u₀ → RealValued u₀ → MeanZero u₀ → hNorm γ u₀ ≤ R →
        ∀ u : ℝ → Fourier, ExactSolution γ T u₀ u →
          ∀ L : ℕ, 0 < L → T / (L : ℝ) ≤ τ₀ →
            maximumError T L u₀ u ≤ C * (T / (L : ℝ)) ^ γ

@[simp] theorem hNorm_zero (s : ℝ) : hNorm s 0 = 0 := by
  simp [hNorm, weighted]

theorem hNorm_add_le {s : ℝ} {f g : Fourier} (hf : InSobolev s f)
    (hg : InSobolev s g) : hNorm s (f + g) ≤ hNorm s f + hNorm s g := by
  rw [hNorm_eq_lpNorm (hf.add hg), hNorm_eq_lpNorm hf, hNorm_eq_lpNorm hg]
  let f' : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 := ⟨weighted s f, hf⟩
  let g' : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2 := ⟨weighted s g, hg⟩
  have h : (⟨weighted s (f + g), hf.add hg⟩ : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2) = f' + g' := by

/-- Li–Wu use unnormalized Lebesgue measure on the period-`2π` torus. -/
def sourceNormalization : ℝ := Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi)

theorem sourceNormalization_pos : 0 < sourceNormalization := by
  unfold sourceNormalization
  positivity

def sourceNorm (s : ℝ) (f : Fourier) : ℝ := sourceNormalization * hNorm s f

/-- The `+` losses in Li–Wu (2.3) are represented by a fixed positive `ε`. -/
def sourceProductExponent (γ ε : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if γ = 0 then 1 / 2 + ε else if γ < 1 / 2 then 1 / 2 - γ
  else if γ = 1 / 2 then ε else 0

/-- Explicit external premise: Li–Wu, author manuscript (2.2)–(2.3).
This imports only the spatial product theorem, with its two positive losses,
and with the source's unnormalized norms. It asserts no numerical estimate. -/
def LiWuProductEstimate : Prop :=
  ∀ γ : ℝ, 0 ≤ γ → γ ≤ 1 → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ f g : Fourier,
      InSobolev γ f → InSobolev (sourceProductExponent γ ε) g →
        InSobolev 0 (product f g) ∧
        sourceNorm 0 (product f g) ≤ C * sourceNorm γ f * sourceNorm (sourceProductExponent γ ε) g

/-- The three lower endpoints in the full cited stage estimate. -/
def sourceStageLower (γ ε : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if γ < 1 / 2 then 2 * γ - 3 / 2 else if γ = 1 / 2 then -1 / 2 - ε else γ - 1

def sourceStagePower (γ ε β : ℝ) : ℝ := (1 + γ - β) / (1 + γ - sourceStageLower γ ε)

/-- Explicit external premise: Li–Wu Lemma 7.2, with the stage represented by
its source endpoint formula (7.3). The bound is bilinear, over the whole source
regularity interval; constants precede the time step, starting time and inputs.
The source's standing zero-mode convention is included. -/
def LiWuStageEstimate : Prop :=
  ∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T → ∀ γ : ℝ, 0 < γ → γ ≤ 1 → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
    ∀ β : ℝ, sourceStageLower γ ε ≤ β → β ≤ 1 + γ →
      ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ τ : ℝ, ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < τ → ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * τ ≤ T →
        t ∈ Set.Icc ((n : ℝ) * τ) (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * τ) → ∀ f g : Fourier,
          InSobolev γ f → InSobolev γ g → MeanZero f → MeanZero g →
            InSobolev β (sourceBilinearStage ((n : ℝ) * τ) t f g) ∧
            sourceNorm β (sourceBilinearStage ((n : ℝ) * τ) t f g) ≤
              C * τ ^ (sourceStagePower γ ε β) * sourceNorm γ f * sourceNorm γ g

/-- Normalization is derived, rather than silently built into the external premise. -/
theorem normalized_product_estimate (externalProduct : LiWuProductEstimate)
    {γ ε : ℝ} (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ f g : Fourier,
      InSobolev γ f → InSobolev (sourceProductExponent γ ε) g →
        InSobolev 0 (product f g) ∧
        hNorm 0 (product f g) ≤ C * hNorm γ f * hNorm (sourceProductExponent γ ε) g := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hb⟩ := externalProduct γ hγ hγ1 ε hε
  refine ⟨C * sourceNormalization, mul_pos hC sourceNormalization_pos, ?_⟩
  intro f g hf hg
  obtain ⟨hm, hn⟩ := hb f g hf hg
  refine ⟨hm, (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ sourceNormalization_pos).mp ?_⟩
  unfold sourceNorm at hn
  nlinarith [hn]

is stronger than merely prescribing an almost-everywhere classical derivative. -/
def WeakTimeDerivative (a b : ℝ) (f df : ℝ → Fourier) : Prop :=

theorem source_flow_coefficient_limit (hL : BITWeakerLipschitz)

    {data : ℕ → Fourier} {f : Fourier} {flows : ℕ → ℝ → Fourier} {v : ℝ → Fourier}

    (hflows : ∀ n, SourceWeakSolution T (data n) (flows n))
    (hflowsC : ∀ n, HomSobolevContinuousOn 0 T (flows n))

hypotheses are explicit here; none is asserted as a literature theorem. -/
theorem local_lipschitz_from_spheres (hL : BITWeakerLipschitz)

      ∀ f g : Fourier, RealValued f → RealValued g → InHomSobolev s f → InHomSobolev s g →

      ∀ v w : ℝ → Fourier, SourceWeakSolution T f v → SourceWeakSolution T g w →

      ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, homogeneousNorm s (v t - w t) ≤ K * homogeneousNorm s (f - g))

    {v : ℝ → Fourier} (hv : SourceWeakSolution T f v) (hvC : HomSobolevContinuousOn s T v) :

  have hfR : homogeneousNorm s f ≤ R := by dsimp [R]; linarith

    dsimp [R]

  let G := fun n => sourceSphereData s R n g hg

  have hGP (n : ℕ) := sourceSphereData_properties hR n g hg hgr hgR
  choose vf hvf hvfC using (fun n : ℕ => hexists (F n) (hFP n).1 (hFP n).2.1)
  choose wg hwg hwgC using (fun n : ℕ => hexists (G n) (hGP n).1 (hGP n).2.1)
  have hf0 : InHomSobolev 0 f := hf.of_le hs.le
  have hg0 : InHomSobolev 0 g := hg.of_le hs.le
  have hF0 (n : ℕ) : InHomSobolev 0 (F n) := (hFP n).2.1.of_le hs.le
  have hG0 (n : ℕ) : InHomSobolev 0 (G n) := (hGP n).2.1.of_le hs.le

    have h1 := homogeneousNorm_mono (hFP n).2.1 hs.le
    have h2 := homogeneousNorm_mono hf hs.le

    linarith
  have hbg (n : ℕ) : homogeneousNorm 0 (G n) + homogeneousNorm 0 g ≤ 4 * R := by
    have h1 := homogeneousNorm_mono (hGP n).2.1 hs.le
    have h2 := homogeneousNorm_mono hg hs.le
    rw [(hGP n).2.2.1] at h1
    linarith
  have hcv := source_flow_coefficient_limit hL hT (show 0 ≤ 4 * R by positivity)
    (fun n => (hFP n).1) hfr hF0 hf0 hbf hvf (fun n => (hvfC n).of_le hs.le)
    hv (hvC.of_le hs.le) (sourceSphereData_L2_converges hs hR f hf hfr hfR)
  have hcw := source_flow_coefficient_limit hL hT (show 0 ≤ 4 * R by positivity)
    (fun n => (hGP n).1) hgr hG0 hg0 hbg hwg (fun n => (hwgC n).of_le hs.le)
    hw (hwC.of_le hs.le) (sourceSphereData_L2_converges hs hR g hg hgr hgR)

    have hh := hb (F n) (G n) (hFP n).1 (hGP n).1 (hFP n).2.1 (hGP n).2.1
      (hFP n).2.2.1 (hGP n).2.2.1 (vf n) (wg n) (hvf n) (hwg n) (hvfC n) (hwgC n) t ht

    (fun n => ((hvfC n).1 t ht).sub ((hwgC n).1 t ht)) hbound
    (fun k => (hcv t ht k).sub (hcw t ht k))).2

end BareModelCompletion

def SourceTwistedEquation (T : ℝ) (f : Fourier) (v : ℝ → Fourier) : Prop :=
